children: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $312.5 million, up 3.7% from a year earlier, while net income attributable to the company rose 12.5% to $75.2 million and diluted EPS increased to $1.04 from $0.93.
Revenue was $312.5M, compared with $301.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 3.7%.
Net income attributable to Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. was $75.2M, compared with $66.8M; YoY change 12.5%.
Diluted EPS was $1.04, compared with $0.93; YoY change 11.8%.
Assets under management ended the quarter at $168.7B after $10.6B in net outflows and $3.8B in market depreciation.
Intermediated Wealth represented 61.2% of AUM, up from 60.2% a year earlier, while Institutional accounted for 38.8%.
Credit and alternatives drew a combined $1.1B in net inflows, offset by $11.6B in outflows from equity strategies.
Grandview added $880M of AUM year to date. Management expects about $2.5B in fourth-quarter fund distributions not to be reinvested.
